name: JP Stein
headline: Head of Commercial at TYTAN Technologies
summary:
As the head of commercial at TYTAN Technologies, it is my mission to set the new standard for Air Defence keeping the skies across Europe safe and re-writing defence economics. 
Values that drive me and my work at TYTAN are impact, trust, and the combination of people, culture
If you are interested in building and growing a world class commercial team with me, please reach out.

schools.school: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
schools.degree: Honor's degree in technology management, Computer/Information Technology Administration and Management

company.name: TYTAN Technologies
company.description: We build AI-powered air defence systems to protect people and critical infrastructure. Our flagship autonomous interceptor detects, tracks, and neutralizes enemy UAVs at high speed with minimal human intervention. Battlefield-tested and developed according to the needs of armed forces, TYTAN delivers cost-efficient, scalable, and interoperable defence solutions. Our mission is to close critical gaps in Europe’s air defence and strengthen democratic resilience through advanced, combat-ready technology.
